_meta.description: Budget guard config for the portfolio-sweep loop. Single source of truth for which model tier runs each stage and the per-run token ceiling. The loop reads this; budget.py enforces it. Same principle templates onto the content loops, where the cap actually bites.
_meta.principle: Cheap models for triage/checking, expensive only where a second opinion is worth paying for. On the weekly sweep the cap barely matters — the point is to build the tiering muscle for higher-cadence loops.

stages.why: judgment: what moved, what to propose, how to phrase
ONLY when verifier flags a real judgment call

caps.note: If the projected total before a stage would exceed the cap, stop and return the partial result rather than silently spending. The cap is sized to fit a normal sweep with headroom; tripping it means something is wrong (a runaway crawl), not a bigger-than-usual week.
